populations.source_context: One institution/source/schema identity. No cross-source PERSON join.
populations.person_table: Accessible PERSON with unique non-null person_id; duplicates/nulls block PERSON-dependent outputs. Includes people with no events/observation.
populations.all_recorded_rows: Every physical row in each readable domain table within declared scope. Default is full table/history including undated, unmapped and orphan rows. Record counts preserve multiplicity; person_count counts only linked unique PERSON members, with excluded record counts visible.
populations.linked_people_with_dated_records: PERSON members with at least one valid dated domain row in scope, independent of observation periods.
populations.raw_observation_intervals: All physical observation_period rows before union, including malformed/orphan rows.
populations.valid_observation_intervals: PERSON-linked finite non-null start/end with end>=start; merge overlaps and adjacency. Invalid rows excluded only with counted reasons.
populations.people_with_valid_intervals: Unique PERSON members with at least one valid merged observation interval.
populations.observed_people: PERSON members with a valid observation union intersecting the declared inclusive period.
populations.observed_rows: PERSON-linked domain rows with finite recorded event DATE in the valid observation union and requested inclusive period. One event once; no span-coverage inference.
populations.observed_year_people: Distinct PERSON members with an observed event in the year, grouped under fixed year/gender/year-age anchor matching the denominator.
populations.requested_outputs: All declared required/conditional profile outputs, whether produced or unavailable.

periods.default: All validated recorded history per domain, plus undated bucket; not a 120-month cap or explicit concept list.
periods.calendar: Finite proleptic Gregorian DATE years 0001..9999, inclusive scope endpoints. Unrepresentable/non-finite dates are flagged, never assigned a fake month.
periods.history_bounds: Record source minima/maxima and generation coverage explicitly per domain and observation; no clipping to the first observed domain or 1900..2099.
periods.optional_limits: Operator-approved narrower history/concepts/modules create an explicitly partial/reduced-scope profile/release with excluded counts and reasons. Never silently truncate the standard baseline.
periods.nonadditivity: Distinct people, first-event age, frequency and quantiles are computed at their declared grain, not rolled up by summing monthly people/averaging monthly summaries.

exact-values.counts: Nonnegative arbitrary-precision integer strings; never JS Number for storage/validation.
exact-values.numeric: Finite source numeric values preserved as exact decimal strings. Float-source adapters require an explicit precision contract and separate evidence; no invented decimal precision.
exact-values.mean: Exact rational (sum,n); displayed rounding is labelled and does not rewrite the exact table.
exact-values.quantiles: Empirical discrete x[ceil(p*n)] for positive n; duplicate physical row multiplicity is preserved.
exact-values.empty: n=0: all statistics including sum/mean are NULL, eligibility counts remain available.
exact-values.eligibility: Every summary counts included, missing, non-finite and domain-specific exclusions explicitly; no silent filtering.
exact-values.excluded: Standard deviation, interpolated/approximate percentiles and unit conversions are not provided in this baseline. Legacy distribution parity is partial, not asserted.

availability-and-completeness.missing_required: Unexpected absent/inaccessible base table or required column blocks the standard complete baseline; explicit reduced profile requires new recorded scope.
availability-and-completeness.conditional_columns: Actual schema/capability evidence, not declared version alone. Unsupported-by-schema conditional panels are reported and do not fabricate zero/missing counts.
availability-and-completeness.empty: Accessible empty table yields known zero counts, empty distributions and explicit empty-source/population. Unavailable/failed/suppressed/not-requested remain distinct.
availability-and-completeness.sparse_zero: A missing sparse cell means zero ONLY inside a successfully computed, integrity-validated declared concept/calendar/strata support with an exact denominator. No absent artifacts or new filters imply zero.
availability-and-completeness.publication: Every required output present/validated or explicitly policy-suppressed, with versioned conditional states; never publish a partial candidate as the full baseline.

concept-and-source-tags.raw: NULL, 0 and each signed integer ID remain distinct raw tags. Unknown/wrong-domain concepts are labelled, not discarded.
concept-and-source-tags.all_concepts: Every concept tag observed in source rows, including unknown/unmapped and explicit null defects; never only top N or vocabulary descendants.
concept-and-source-tags.lookups: Unique-key LEFT lookups only. Conflicting duplicate vocabulary/dimension keys fail affected semantic outputs, never multiply rows.
concept-and-source-tags.hierarchy: No descendant expansion/treemap hierarchy roll-up in this baseline; concept browse uses saved flat counts.
concept-and-source-tags.text: Default source panel exports concept pairs and text presence, not raw strings. No note, observation text, value_source_value, device IDs or specimen identifiers in distributable artifacts.

contracts.serving: Batch-only R/CLI/scheduled source execution; all UI/API/ATLAS reads use pinned precomputed aggregates. No per-concept source jobs or chart-time CDM SQL.
contracts.disclosure: Restricted generation is default. No synthetic policy is assumed for institutions; approved exports apply institution policy and physically omit restricted values. Denominator/overlapping-summary disclosure review is required, not just chart hiding.

eligibility-reasons.numeric_summary_notes: Use first matching reason. For observation omit the operator reason; do not create an operator column. All reason counts reconcile to physical concept rows.
eligibility-reasons.date_presence: DATE presence is a representation flag, not a distribution of date values. Schema-absent is distinct from null in an existing column.
eligibility-reasons.numeric_summary_groups: Emit n=0 with NULL stats for each observed allowed known-unit/NULL-or-0 operator stratum even when no row is eligible; excluded unit/operator strata are explained in counts. Do not invent cross-products of unit/operator combinations never observed.
eligibility-reasons.age_proxy: The 0..130 proxy eligibility interval is a declared descriptive policy in this revision, not validated clinical age. Unknown/invalid buckets retain counts; no inferred birthday. Any policy change requires a metric version change.

strata-and-support.capture: Precompute concept_tag=ALL (domain total) separately from raw concept tags; ALL is a reserved typed selector, never concept 0/NULL. The same applies to period full_scope vs calendar. Record totals are additive over disjoint concept/date buckets; distinct-person totals are computed directly.
strata-and-support.type_and_source: Whole-source-history concept marginals only, not a joint concept/type/source/date cube. No raw source text groups in default output.
strata-and-support.summaries: Whole-scope summaries only, except observation coverage/calendar counts. Monthly numeric/age summaries require a newly declared batch scope; never synthesize them from whole-scope or average summaries.
strata-and-support.histograms: Event-count and distinct-concept histograms are whole-scope, not monthly. Zero-people cells need complete PERSON denominator and valid distinct-person counts.
strata-and-support.first_age: First dated record within declared generation history, not first lifetime event, incident disease or a retrospective claim before the dataset starts.
strata-and-support.schema_absent: Typed schema_absent tags are separate from null/zero; no schema-absent column is queried by a generated SQL module.
strata-and-support.representation_support: Emit all supported Boolean combinations for each observed concept. For 5.3/5.4 observation date is schema_absent in every combination, not a false Boolean.
strata-and-support.empty_domain: Domain ALL total is zero with empty_domain; concept catalogue empty. Do not allocate all vocabulary concepts or fabricate a concept-0 record.
strata-and-support.reference_summary: No raw numeric frequency/value rows are distributable by default; exact summary/eligibility counts are released under institution policy.

metrics.calculation: Declared and observed CDM/schema/vocabulary/source identity, profile+metric revisions, full requested scope, actual coverage, generation/as-of time and unknown identity reasons. Never infer a snapshot from max event date.
Probe precisely the physical dependencies in this manifest; absent, inaccessible, present-empty and present-readable differ. A declared CDM version does not override observed columns.

Account for every required metric and conditional feature. Unavailable conditional fields are explicit unsupported-by-schema; unexpected missing/inaccessible required dependencies block publication. Policy-approved suppression carries completeness evidence.
Measured monotonic wall time; optional physical-work/cost telemetry is labelled missing when unavailable, never inferred from wall time.
Count unique PERSON members by the raw recorded gender_concept_id; NULL, 0 and other values remain distinct. No demographic imputation.
Count unique PERSON members by the raw recorded year_of_birth; NULL, 0 and other values remain distinct. No demographic imputation.
Count unique PERSON members by the raw recorded race_concept_id; NULL, 0 and other values remain distinct. No demographic imputation.
Count unique PERSON members by the raw recorded ethnicity_concept_id; NULL, 0 and other values remain distinct. No demographic imputation.
COUNT(DISTINCT person_id); null/duplicate PERSON IDs fail PERSON-dependent metrics; zero on an accessible empty PERSON table.
Count PERSON members by the exact joint recorded dimensions. Preserve NULL/zero categories; no inference from absence of DEATH.
Count PERSON members by the exact joint recorded dimensions. Preserve NULL/zero categories; no inference from absence of DEATH.

Merge overlapping and adjacent valid inclusive PERSON intervals, clip to each declared period and count unique people and union person-days. A partial edge period is labelled clipped. Never sum monthly people to a window count.

At least one observed day in year. Age proxy is calendar year minus year_of_birth, the SAME year anchor used by observed domain numerators; negative or >130 and absent birth year use explicit unknown/invalid-age categories. All recorded genders retained. One person once in that year/gender/age bucket.

Merged observation union covers every day of the actual full calendar month/year. Partial boundary periods are not called full-year/month observation. Also record clipped-window coverage as a separate scope.

First merged start per PERSON; year(start)-year_of_birth is labelled approximate year-age, not precise birthday age. Valid proxy 0..130; missing/invalid counted separately. Use exact summary contract.

metrics.grain: person at first merged start/approximate year-age/gender
metrics.calculation: Count linked people by approximate year-age at first merged observation start and recorded gender. Preserve invalid/unknown age buckets under the same 0..130 descriptive policy; this is a histogram, separate from summary quantiles.

Inclusive days of first merged interval per PERSON, before scope clipping; observation union removes overlap. Exact summary, stratified by recorded gender and approximate year-age decile including unknown.
Bucket FLOOR(inclusive first merged interval days/30). This intentionally differs from legacy exclusive DATEDIFF and arbitrary first-row ties.
Count merged valid intervals per PERSON, including zero intervals. Non-additive across windows; default uses full recorded observation history.
Count merged interval starts and ends by calendar month and distinct linked people independently; starts/ends are not ongoing observed population.
Count all physical observation_period rows by raw period type without interval union; do not confuse type totals with union lengths.
Total inclusive merged observed days per PERSON, bucketed in 30-day increments; includes zero and is separate from first-interval length.

Exactly one category in order: null person, orphan person, null endpoints, reversed interval, valid. Invalid intervals remain in this aggregate and are excluded with visible counts from coverage; do not substitute a zero for failed prerequisites.

metrics.grain: concept/period; records and linked distinct people are separate measures
metrics.calculation: Count physical source rows once by raw standard concept tag. Count distinct valid PERSON members separately. Precompute full declared scope, each month and each year; undated rows remain in full-scope counts and an explicit undated bucket, not a fabricated month. Dated subperiod counts never silently include undated rows.
metrics.denominator: core.person.count for full-scope people only; no all-recorded/observed-population ratio

metrics.calculation: Count records and linked people for raw source-concept-to-standard-concept pairs. Source text exports ONLY null/blank/nonblank presence states; raw text, patient IDs and unique source identifiers never enter public aggregates. Specimen has no source-concept column: use unsupported-by-schema, not concept 0. Raw source-string breakdown is a separate restricted future module.
Count physical records and linked people by the recorded type without vocabulary inner joins or concept roll-up. NULL, zero, unknown and known concept IDs retain raw identity.

For each linked PERSON/concept find earliest valid recorded event date in scope; take year(event)-year_of_birth. Summarize one approximate year-age per person/concept, by gender, using exact summary contract. Missing/invalid ages and people without dated events have explicit eligibility counts. No observation requirement and no incident diagnosis/onset claim.

metrics.grain: person/concept/physical event count in full scope
metrics.calculation: Histogram number of physical records per linked PERSON/concept, including event-count=0 computed as PERSON total minus distinct linked people for that concept. All observed concept tags only. Excluded orphan/null people appear in integrity counts. Cumulative >=x counts derive from this saved histogram and denominator core.person.count; not from chart-time CDM queries.

Count distinct raw non-null concept tags per linked PERSON across full scope, retaining concept 0. Null concept is an explicit integrity defect and is not a distinct concept. Histogram includes PERSON members with zero qualifying concepts.

Independent boolean marginals for null/orphan person, missing/invalid date, null/zero/unknown/wrong-domain concept, and missing/reversed end where applicable. Marginals may overlap and are never summed as mutually exclusive people or rows. Vocabulary identity is a LEFT lookup; no clinical row multiplication. Duplicate record IDs are flagged without deduplicating physical rows; DEATH uses repeated person rows, not an invented death_id.

One row category in order: null/orphan person, undated, no valid intervals, outside valid union, inside valid union. Membership is an EXISTS lookup into merged intervals at event_date, never a multiplicative join. Category record counts sum to full-scope capture records. Distinct people can appear in several categories and are NOT additive; percentages require the declared record or any-event-person denominator.

Physical source rows linked to valid PERSON and dated within at least one valid inclusive merged observation interval and requested period. Count once; separately distinct people per full window/month/year. Saved numerator/denominator scope is explicit; denominator is same-period observed people, not person-time or disease prevalence.

Distinct linked people with an observed event during the year; assign year-age using calendar year minus year_of_birth, exactly the denominator year anchor. No single person moves between age buckets within a year. All genders and explicit unknown/invalid age buckets retained. A recorded-event share, not incidence or validated prevalence. Include a concept_tag=ALL subtotal computed as a separate distinct-person grouping; never sum concept people.
